name: 14223-sharegpt-1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 1.24B parameters, bf16. ~2.5 GB of weights; KV is 32 KiB per token. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 256, warmup 10% and cooldown 10% by completion, bounded at 2560 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. 256 sits inside the declared `max-num-seqs`.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, `temperature: 0.0`. Prompt EXACTLY 215 tokens and output EXACTLY 180 (min = max, zero dispersion); `ignore_eos` is forced whenever an output length is declared, so every request generates exactly 180 tokens.
purpose: A compact one-billion-parameter assistant answering 256 concurrent single-turn questions with fixed short prompts and replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for the pinned commit; the interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
generation-config: auto
disable-log-requests: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
